environment.concurrency: single process; sequential <=100-item chunks; cargo test -j1
environment.cache_state: no drop_caches; retained inputs and baseline DB copied between runs, so update/profile runs are warm-page-cache measurements

phase_definitions.initial: materialize = snapshot member decode/materialization + validation; prepare = immutable collection candidate construction; commit = one task transaction
phase_definitions.update: spec = per-item head/digest reads; accept = task acceptance; prepare = task binding + base facts/window + candidate decision excluding provider call; acquire = provider.acquire_typed (member read, member sha256, event read/digest, continuity classification, typed segment assembly); commit = commit_update_batch transaction; fallback_* = per-item run_item fallback wall plus nested typed/envelope provider acquisition

unverified: No claim about optimization priority or bottleneck beyond sampled symbols and stage timings
Profile run is used only for hotspot distribution; absolute timings come from unprofiled runs
